speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: Singapore remains an attractive cruise hub for many cruise lines, given our year-round tropical climate and strong market potential here and in the region.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: Pre-COVID-19, Singapore had the most cruise ship calls amongst ports in Asia.
